static_covariates.missing: NaN replaced by 0 from first retained row; no static normalization

normalization.entries: all observed entries over retained hours, before horizon eligibility filtering
normalization.missing_values: NaN->0 in archive, then ((v-mean)/std)*mask in loader; no forward-fill or interpolation

windows_per_stay_proof.reason: idx contains each eligible stay once; __len__=len(idx); __getitem__ fixes the start at hour 0

masked_RMSE.aggregation: observed target entries pooled across stays, hours <H, and all variables before square root
